items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the not-for-profit corporation law, in relation to exempting the real property of a land bank from certain sewer rent and user charges imposed by the state of New York and by any of its political subdivisions
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S4346

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the not-for-profit corporation law,
in relation to exempting the real property of a land bank from certain
sewer rent and user charges imposed by the state of New York and by
any of its political subdivisions

 PURPOSE :

To exempt land banks from sewer rent and other user charges imposed by
the State or localities

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

A chapter amendment, this bill amends chapter 441 of the laws of 2016
to specifically exempt land banks from sewer rent and other user
charges imposed by the State or localities

 EXISTING LAW :

Land Banks are currently exempt from taxation by the state and any of
its political subdivisions as well as from special ad valorem levies
and special assessments, a clarification inserted last year.

 JUSTIFICATION :

Land banks are created by a locality or in an agreement with multiple
locality. The funding land banks receive are either from private
donation for the public good, or from the State or local government.
Any tax or fee paid by the land bank to the state or locality is
either its own funds being returned to it or prevention from putting
properties back into the property tax rolls undercutting the purpose
of land banks.

Upon the creation of land banks in statute, they were originally
exempt from all taxation. However, as municipalities explore more ways
to pay for the services it provides, they have come up with other ways
to charge is citizens and businesses or have interpreted exemptions
narrowly. It is against the legislative intent that created land banks
to allow them to be taxed in this manner and undermines the purpose of
the land bank to only reduce the benefits that a land bank can provide
to its enacting jurisdiction.

This legislation amends legislation enacted last year that makes it
clear that land banks are not subject to state or local taxation,
something that was important upon the creation of land banks in
statute and important to its overarching purpose in the community
which it operates: to address blight and abandoned properties and turn
them into tax paying, community enhancing properties.

There were manners of taxation that are not clearly delineated in last
year's chapter, this bill aims to correct that and exempt land banks
from all taxation, as the original intent states.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New bill amending chapter 441 of the laws of 2016

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

Not determined

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately
